rationale: The agent executed multiple order- and account-changing actions (modify_pending_order_address, modify_pending_order_items, modify_user_address) without first authenticating the user beyond an email lookup and without seeking explicit user confirmation prior to each change, both of which violate the stated policy. Additionally, the tablet exchange was set to a specific model/price without evidence it was the cheapest option as requested. The final message also disclosed the full address despite the user’s desire not to reveal it themselves. While the actions may have targeted the correct user/orders, the lack of authentication and confirmation before writes, plus the unsupported claim about the exchanged item being the cheapest, mean the request was not completed in line with policy.
